summary: Frontend retest of Periodización Fases 4/5 on Super Admin plan 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)'. Confirmed selector-hint fixes from iteration_111 (view-chart, table-cell-load_percent, duplicate-meso via macro expansion). Successfully navigated to Estructura and validated all view tab testids and top-bar action buttons (undo/history/compare). End-to-end interactive flows (edit -> autosave text, restore, duplicate click, comparator select) could NOT be reliably exercised in a single Playwright session due to a flaky post-login race between sidebar-plan click and top-bar section-tab render (nav-datos disappears intermittently on rerender). This is a state/navigation flakiness issue, NOT a bug in the Fase 4/5 features being tested.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking sidebar-plan-{id} card inside plans-sheet, sometimes activePlan/activePanel do not propagate: PLAN ACTIVO widget shows 'Sin plan seleccionado' and section-tab-periodizacion / subnav-period-structure are not rendered. Repeats every 2nd session. Only reliable path is: login -> Planes sheet -> sidebar-plan click -> WAIT >3s -> nav-datos -> section-tab-periodizacion -> subnav-period-structure. Suggest awaiting loadPlanData completion before dispatching plan-data-updated so PLAN ACTIVO widget reflects state consistently.

action_items: Investigate the flaky post-login race where clicking sidebar-plan does not always set activePlan / render section-tabs. Suggest: (a) block sheet close until handleSetActivePlan resolves; (b) add a dedicated data-testid on the top-nav 'Periodización' section tab that is visible without requiring activePlan+activePanel==='datos' combination just for testability.
Verify sr-only DialogTitle was added to ALL Sheet/Dialog components — 2 DialogTitle warnings still appear on initial dashboard render (source likely plans-sheet, athletes sheet, or another dialog).

Consider self-testing the autosave->undo->history->restore->duplicate->comparator flow manually to verify since retest could not reproducibly reach that state in Playwright due to app-state race, not selector issues.
critical_code_review_comments: handleSetActivePlan in DashboardPage.js (line 369) fires setShowPlanSelector(false) at end but the sheet closes via onSelectPlan callback BEFORE loadPlanData resolves — this causes intermittent PLAN ACTIVO widget stale render.
PeriodizationComplete.js remains >3500 lines; recommend splitting FAB, filters bar, history dialog, comparator into sub-components (repeated from it_111).
Multiple Sheet/Dialog components across the app may be missing sr-only DialogTitle — do a global audit rather than patch-by-patch.

success_rate.frontend: Selector contract 100% verified (all testids from spec exist). E2E interactive flow ~30% verified due to nav race blocking retest reruns.

rca_of_the_issue: Selector hints from iteration_111 were indeed wrong (vol vs load_percent, view-graphic vs view-chart, duplicate-meso needs expansion). All selectors from the current review-request are present in code and match. The remaining blocker is a NAVIGATION RACE between plan selection and section-tab render — this is a real code bug (handleSetActivePlan calling setShowPlanSelector(false) before loadPlanData resolves, and section-tab visibility being gated on both activePanel==='datos' AND activePlan simultaneously). Recommend making the plan selection await loadPlanData before closing the sheet.
